parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` within the `Artwork` package. Although the two methods — `CacheCoordinatorArtworkTests.fetchesCachedArtworkWithoutReleaseTitle` (line 593) and `CacheCoordinatorArtworkTests.skipsEmptyReleaseTitle` (line 649) — share a Jaccard similarity of ~0.71, their distinct names indicate they are testing meaningfully different behavioural scenarios (cached artwork with no release title vs. skipping an empty release title). Near-duplicate test bodies are common when exercising closely related edge cases and collapsing them risks obscuring the intent of each individual scenario.
